name: Inox Green Energy Services Ltd
tagline: India's only listed pure-play wind O&M company, with long-term (5-20yr) locked-in contracts riding the wind-capacity buildout - but weak capital efficiency (ROE ~5.6%) and a rich ~56x P/E leave no valuation cushion.
business_overview: Inox Green Energy Services Ltd (NSE: INOXGREEN) is part of the INOX Wind group and provides operations & maintenance (O&M) services for wind turbine generators (WTGs) and common infrastructure, under long-term contracts of 5-20 years tied to INOX Wind's installed fleet and third-party wind assets. Entity confirmed via screener.in/NSE - unambiguous match to the state.json name 'Inox Green Energy'.
fundamentals_table: ROCE ~8.42%; ROE ~5.62% (3-yr avg only ~3.18%) - weak capital efficiency
P/E ~56.5x; Book value ~Rs 42.5 - richly priced for the return profile
5-yr sales growth only ~10.3% (poor); 5-yr profit CAGR ~21.5% (better, likely cost/scale driven)
Rs 132.58 - Rs 279 - currently well off the high
fundamentals_narrative: The business model is genuinely differentiated - India's only listed pure-play wind O&M provider with long-duration (5-20yr) contracted revenue tied to a growing installed wind fleet, and the balance sheet has been cleaned up (almost debt-free). But the return ratios undercut the story: ROE of just ~5.6% (3-yr average ~3.18%) is weak, and a ~56.5x P/E leaves essentially no valuation margin of safety if growth or margins disappoint. Revenue growth itself has been poor (~10.3% over 5 years); most of the profit CAGR (~21.5%) looks to be coming from cost/scale efficiencies and debt reduction rather than volume growth.
technical_read: Trading at ~Rs 172 against a 52-week range of Rs 132.58-279 - roughly 38% off the high, in the lower-middle of the range.
